title: The pull-up: what it REALLY works (and how to get your first one) 💪
caption:
Lats, mid back, biceps and grip. Palms facing you = chin-up = more biceps. Can't do one yet? Slow negatives and bands. How many can you do? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 4
first_comment: How many pull-ups in a row? Drop your number 👇
